Title: Stand-in Frog's Weaponry WWII Pack
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Weapon_Frogs_Weaponry_WWII folder
name and the shape its port reads on the stand-in Frog's Weaponry, so the
listed port applies to it. It is not the original Add-On and holds none of
its files, and its gun, names and numbers are its own.
